title: Zero-length root-power prefix
statement: Let $\ell$ be a nonnegative integer, let $m,y$ be length-$\ell$ vectors over $\mathbb F_2$, and let $\alpha$ be a root adjoined for $X^\ell+\sum_{i<\ell}m_iX^i$. The empty sum of root powers with coefficients from $y$ is zero: $\sum_{i<0} y_i\alpha^i=0$.
hypotheses_covered: $m$ and $y$ are length-$\ell$ vectors over $\mathbb F_2$
